request.text: The SAM registry hive appears to have been dumped on WORKSTATION5. Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: An encoded PowerShell process (PID 5972) running as pgustavo with high integrity started reg.exe with 'reg save HKLM\sam sam', and reg.exe wrote the SAM hive to C:\Windows\System32\sam. This is credential dumping from the local SAM on WORKSTATION5; isolate the host now.
